description: Button designed for use inside TmToolbar. Supports icon-only, text-only, or icon+text layouts with ghost, primary, and danger variants.

parameters.name: Badge
parameters.description: A short count or marker shown as a small pill on the button (e.g. the number of active filters). Decorative (aria-hidden): put the meaning in Tooltip, the accessible name of an icon button. Null or empty renders nothing.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: Button label text. Omit for icon-only buttons.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Icon name from IconNames. Displayed before the text.

parameters.name: Tooltip
parameters.description: Tooltip text shown as the native title attribute.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.description: Fires when the button is clicked.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: When true, the button is disabled.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the button element.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: How important the button is when its TmToolbar runs out of room (Menu). An overflow rank only: buttons render in written order.

parameters.name: LabelPosition
parameters.description: Where the Text label sits: next to the icon (default), under it, or hidden (the text then stays the accessible name). Only an icon button can hide its label.

parameters.name: Pressed
parameters.description: Makes the button a toggle: null (default) is a plain button with no aria-pressed; true/false render aria-pressed and the pressed look, and when the button sits in a TmToolbar's "More" menu it becomes a menuitemcheckbox with the same state (aria-checked). The host owns the state: flip it in OnClick. A host-splatted aria-pressed (AdditionalAttributes) still wins on the bar button.

parameters.name: PressedMixed
parameters.description: Renders a toggle whose Pressed is false as partially on — aria-pressed="mixed" on the bar, aria-checked="mixed" in "More" (e.g. Bold over a partly bold selection). Ignored when Pressed is null or true.

parameters.name: PreserveFocus
parameters.description: When true, pressing the button with a mouse, pen or finger does not move focus to it (the pointerdown and mousedown defaults are prevented), so an editor's text selection survives a formatting command. Keyboard activation and the "More" entry are unchanged. Default false.
